note: The PR-14A bracket gate: three commanders at each bracket, fifteen builds (D-451). Every prompt is Commander, any card, no collection. The commanders of brackets 1 to 3 come from the deck gate prompts, so a name that resolves there resolves here. Brackets 4 and 5 name commanders that lead optimized and cEDH lists. A -dry run resolves every name and builds every shortlist for free.
